#   capabilities capability ids from capabilities.tsv (semicolon-separated), or NONE.
#   note         why the entry is representative; verdicts are NEVER written here -- derived.
# HISTORICAL capability ids are the INVERSION of the corpus_programs citations in capabilities.tsv;
# NONE means no capability cites that program (absence is not a verdict). Registration kind is not
# asserted here -- tools/functional_dashboard.py resolves names via panel_keys.load()/census/RUNTIME.
